summary: Explains why the IPv6 flow label specification in RFC 3697 needed to change. Published proposals for using the label conflicted with the original text, and the label saw little real use, partly because of unclear wording. It motivates the changes made in RFC 6437 and is informational.

eli5.summary: A sticker was meant to group related packets, but the rules for it were fuzzy so nobody used it much. This explains why to clarify the rules and give a bit more freedom.

questions: why was the ipv6 flow label updated
